ANATOMICAL GEOMETRY
BodyParts3D, The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan.
Z-Anatomy, The open source atlas of anatomy, CC BY-SA 4.0.
GLB conversion: nqwrc/3d-anatomy (https://github.com/nqwrc/3d-anatomy), nervous.glb.
Upstream distribution includes additional contributions; see ANATOMY-LICENSE.txt.
This filtered, regrouped and simplified geometry is distributed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/).
Changes for this educational presentation: omitted sensory organs, meninges and fluid spaces; grouped meshes for interaction; simplified surfaces; recomputed normals and recolored for rendering.
Sources: https://www.z-anatomy.com/ ; https://lifesciencedb.jp/bp3d/ ; https://github.com/nqwrc/3d-anatomy
